label: About
title: About Black Earth Dropout Slab
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 73 recent saved-signal files and 73 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Destroying Angels and multithread 02_Digital Occultism by Sophie Publig & Mikkel Rørbo, plus 7 more. A source image from i.ytimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Black Earth Dropout Slab: Black-earth audio cover rupture, poster crop, side-lit object slab: center a square near-black plate inside dark gray pillar margins, stacked as skull-aperture mass, thin measure band, and broad chipped lower title-edge mass. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central skull aperture mass, long chipped lower ridge, and vertical torn stitch seam.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
